'''Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy''' is the 28th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 10 January 2001. It is 154 cards (77 per side): 34 very rare foils, 62 super rare foils, 4 ultra rare foils, and 54 premium cards, plus five foil box/case toppers.

Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below, two unique premiums (listed under Card list), and random reprints. Those reprints are not listed. Some packs did not contain a Japanese card. A foil of a title that is not on this list (and is not one of the box/case toppers) is not a Decipher Reflections II pack foil.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Box toppers ==
Displays shipped with foil '''box toppers''' of Enhanced Premiere characters, plus a Japanese [[Darth Vader]] '''case topper'''. These titles also appear on the foil print sheets (two copies per sheet) and are playable foils:<ref name="encyc" />

* [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (Reflections II Foil)|Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]]
* [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (Reflections II Foil)|Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]]
* [[Leia With Blaster Rifle (Reflections II Foil)|Leia With Blaster Rifle]]
* [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]]
* Japanese [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] (case topper)


== Japanese-language foils ==
Complete Card List v4 marks six Reflections II pack/case foils as Japanese-language printings. [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] is the case topper. The others are pack foils listed below. These are Japanese-language foils inside Reflections II, not a Japanese Reflections set.<ref name="checklist-foils">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30–31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] (R10, P, case topper)
* [[Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Death Star]] (R32, SR)
* [[Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Imperial Walker]] (R49, SR)
* [[Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Brainiac]] (R56, SR)
* [[Leia (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Leia]] (R63, SR)
* [[Rebel Snowspeeder (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Rebel Snowspeeder]] (R104, SR)

== Print sheets ==
Foils and premiums are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Light foil sheet: 3 box toppers 2&times;, 1 ultra rare, 15 very rare 3&times;, 34 super rare 2&times;, 1 blank. Dark foil sheet: 1 case topper 2&times;, 1 box topper 2&times;, 1 ultra rare, 19 very rare 3&times;, 28 super rare 2&times;, 1 blank. Premium sheet: 27 titles (15 four times and 12 five times) plus 1 blank.<ref name="encyc" />

[[Category:Decipher sets]]

== Foil cards ==
<span id="Possible_foils"></span>
100 pack foils: 34 very rare, 62 super rare, 4 ultra rare ([[Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]] Light; [[Emperor Palpatine]], [[Lord Vader]], and [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] Dark), plus the five box/case toppers above.<ref name="encyc" />

Click a card image or title to open that foil printing. Have a clearer scan? [[Special:Upload|Contribute a scan]] of the complete card, including its borders, title, text and symbols. Identify the set, language and foil finish on the File page. <span aria-hidden="true">📷</span> '''Scan requested''' marks a missing image; existing photographs remain visible.
